# The 100 most valuable books in the world

I'm interpreting “most valuable” as **the most expensive and collectible books, manuscripts, and historical documents ever sold**, ranked by reported sale value.

These are not ordinary bookstore prices. Their value comes from historical significance, extreme rarity, famous authorship, condition, and provenance.

One important distinction: a handwritten original manuscript can be worth vastly more than a printed first edition of the same work.
